cohort.definition: Union of top 100 Peru users by followers and top 100 in each committers.top category; accounts present in four or more country rankings or with explicit non-Peru location evidence excluded.

limitations: Explicit source-ranking contradictions are curated in peru-exclusions.json.
Stars, forks, followers, and external repositories are cumulative.
Activity and collaboration use trailing 365-day public windows.
Stars and forks cover the 100 most-starred public, non-fork repositories owned by each user.
Private activity and contribution size are excluded for comparability.
